exact_statement: Refinement of v5, with inherited statements at their original scope: for arbitrary Boolean seed b, distinct controlled vertex flips on independent controls, and any positive normalized complete data spectral reference Q, CE_Q(P_data)-CE_Q(P_b)=-4*2^-k E sum_{x in D,y outside D} b(x)b(y)K_Q(x xor y), K_Q(d)=2^-k sum_S log2(1/Q(S))chi_S(d). Full H(F)=CE_Q(P_b)+L+kV+phi(1-V)-2^-k sum_j phi(mu_j^2)+W_Q-M-D(P_joint||Q tensor R), with exact controller marginal R and actual influence including adjacent E(A_j A_l) correction as in REPORT(1)-(6). The fixed original bank C I(b)-CE_Q(P_b)-U pays iff REPORT(7) holds; no reset is implied. Product references have zero kernel between vertices differing in two blocks. For b=g^{tensor t}, t>=2, g=-1 only at 000 on three bits, every single-vertex flip activated by any independent indicator A satisfies H(F)+U<=4I_data(F)+2^(-3t)H(1-2A) for 0<=U<=t/64. Full FEI and arbitrary mixed-history bank eligibility remain open.
